title.narrative: Accompanying BDD Shabunda processing Mutuals of solidarity

description.narrative: BDD Shabunda implements in partnership with CDJP Bukavu a Recovery Project of women victims of sexual violence in Shabunda territory since 2012. This project has managed to reintegrate into the communities 648 women and girls who had been victims of trauma and sexual violence in Shabunda territory. BDD has managed to organize six women's associations from the project goshawks food security activities (agriculture and livestock) as well as income generating activities. In April 2014 during the program assessment workshop Simama, outings strategy of actions had been recommended including the migration of women's associations in mutual of solidarity. Due to the lack of resources it has not been possible to organize this exercise. The partners propose that the training workshop being organized by CAFOD directly given the necessary expertise for such training. The interest of this training is to stranghten the achievements of Simama program improving its sustainability in the Shabunda territory.
